name: Le Royal Monceau - Raffles Paris
insider_take: Where Philippe Starck's avant-garde vision meets Parisian elegance, creating an artistic sanctuary steps from the Arc de Triomphe.
whats_special: This palace hotel features Europe's largest hotel spa by Clarins, a private cinema designed by Philippe Starck, and an impressive contemporary art collection with pieces rotating from major galleries. The hotel's Matsuhisa restaurant marks Nobu's only Parisian outpost, while the rooftop garden offers rare greenery in central Paris.
pro_tip: Book the Art Concierge service for exclusive gallery tours and private viewings - they'll arrange access to artist studios and exhibitions not open to the general public.
dont_miss: The hidden speakeasy-style Long Bar with its 10-meter zinc counter, and the hotel's "My Blend by Clarins" personalized skincare lab where you can create custom beauty products. The nearby Jacquemart-André Museum (5-minute walk) houses one of Paris's finest private art collections.
pros: Prime location near Arc de Triomphe and Champs-Élysées
Award-winning art collection and contemporary design by Philippe Starck
World-class La Prairie spa and state-of-the-art fitness facilities
Michelin-starred dining at Il Carpaccio and innovative cocktail bar
Exceptional personalized butler service and luxury amenities
cons: Contemporary art-focused design may not appeal to traditional luxury preferences
